- Lines 102-110: `<ExerciseCard ... locked={locked} ... />`. The `moduleName` prop is `item.moduleName` (line 104).

So on the learn route, "module" cards are actually **courses** (one card per `Course`), each labeled with its `course.moduleName`. The learn route flattens the entire content model to two levels — `Course -> Exercise[]` — there is no concept of a module group linking multiple courses (the `moduleName` field is just a display label shared by several courses). See confirmation of shared `moduleName`s in section 2.
